title: Missing 1 node path when drag and dropping multiple node paths with CTRL
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in godot 4.6.3, 4.7.1 and 4.8 dev1.

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS 22.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 535.309.01) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads) - 15.42 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When selecting multiple nodes and drag and dropping them into a script while holding CTRL to add `@onready var` pointing to the node path, the last selected node won't be added to the script if CTRL was held while clicking on the last selected node and the last selected node was already selected before clicking on it.

This bug won't happen if:
- we select the nodes, begin to drag and drop and then we hold CTRL.
- we hold ALT instead of CTRL to have `@export`. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/21baf0e2-a48e-44e9-88c5-e0f1166e348f

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a scene
2. Add 3 nodes as a child of the root node
4. Select the 3 nodes
5. Hold CTRL
6. Click on the selection to start drag and dropping
7. The last selected node will be deselected
8. Finish to drag and drop to the script, we will only have 2 node paths.
